independentReviewers.scope: semantic boundary, lifecycle, operation classification, event contract, acceptance and execution authority
authorization descriptors, purpose separation, action exposure, default-off, migration scope, RLS and lease authority

resolvedFindings.finding: IAQ-011 PAGE and DATA used lifecycle command purpose instead of the authoritative HR_OPERATIONS read purpose.
resolvedFindings.resolution: PAGE and DATA now use HR_OPERATIONS at Gateway and owner; only the ACTION maps HR_LIFECYCLE to owner-fixed SEPARATION_CASE.

resolvedFindings.finding: The IAQ action allowlist did not bind action visibility to item eligibility, field VIEW decisions and preliminary PEP-HRM-013.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Both PAGE and DATA projections now omit the action unless all target, nonterminal-case, field-decision and preliminary-PEP guards pass.

resolvedFindings.finding: Product authorization v61 and Auth V270 were described as reserved while their machine state remained candidate-only.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Both central versions are RESERVED_NOT_ACTIVE with explicit true reservation booleans; People database V61 remains NOT_ISSUED.

resolvedFindings.finding: XCON-028 had no design-time consumer set even though the codegen manifest requires one.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Design consumers are sealed to HRIS-PER, HRIS-TIM and HRIS-PAY while production subscriptions and handlers remain zero.

resolvedFindings.finding: The new capability and predicate descriptors omitted canonical fields needed for deterministic v61 generation.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Responsibility requirement, owner, policy version, lifecycle, legacy and sunset values plus closed predicate evidence and parameter schemas are now exact and validator-checked.

resolvedFindings.finding: REPLAY_NOOP was modeled as a persisted callback outcome despite append-only unique callback identity.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Persisted outcomes are ACCEPTED, REJECTED or QUARANTINED; REPLAY_NOOP is response or telemetry disposition over the existing immutable row.

resolvedFindings.finding: The five-field WorkerSeparated business payload was not explicitly separated from the common canonical event data required for envelope equality.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The contract now seals five business fields and fourteen canonical data fields separately, with eight exact outer-data equalities and payload digest scope.

verifiedBoundaries: HRM-013 excludes general LEAVE, RETURN and ppl_employment_absence_periods.
Only createSeparationCase is a public PEP; every non-create transition remains trusted internal with no invented public route.
The exact six-state lifecycle, idempotency tuple, CAS, callback replay fence and twelve acceptance conditions are closed.
XCON-028 is append-only after XCON-027 with five business fields, closed canonical data and no production binding or subscription.
Product authorization v61 and Auth V270 are reserved but inactive; the feature is OFF with zero global activation and zero tenant enrollment.
People V61 is a named candidate with an exact manifest only; no reservation, lease, SQL or module source authority exists.
No owner packet, module worktree, module token, route mount, menu mount, production binding or later Batch-06 lane is authorized.
nonClaims: Central or module source has been authored, committed, pushed or admitted.
A central or module worktree or executable token exists.
People V61 is reserved or active.
Any route, menu, feature, tenant, event publisher or consumer is active.
HRM-013, Batch-06, R7 or HRIS is complete.
